verdict.rationale: Jules documents its own API for headless automation. Users create API keys, start sessions, send messages and approve plans programmatically, and an optional automationMode field controls automatic PR creation. GitHub label-based task assignment adds a non-interactive trigger. Nothing documents a CLI, a GitHub Action or any first-party CI-pipeline integration, and plan approval may need explicit handling. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action or CI recipe), a headless CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of running Jules in CI pipelines.
